name: Full Vessel Deployment Pipeline
description: Complete CI/CD deployment for vessels with version checking, submodule management, and helm release recovery. Uses bash resolvers for full determinism.

variables.name: vesselName
variables.description: Name of the vessel to deploy (e.g., 'metabob-activity-api')

variables.name: environment
variables.description: Target environment: local, canary, or production

variables.name: mainRepo
variables.description: Path to main vessel repo for version comparison (e.g., 'repos/metabob-activity-api'). Empty to skip version check.

variables.name: skipSubmoduleUpdate
variables.description: Skip submodule clean and update steps

tasks.description: Compare versions between main repo, deployment submodule, and production values

config.command: MAIN_REPO='{{mainRepo}}'; DEPLOY_REPO='{{deploymentRepo}}'; VESSEL='{{vesselName}}'; ENV='{{environment}}'; if [ -z "$MAIN_REPO" ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: mainRepo not specified'; exit 0; fi; echo '=== Version Comparison ==='; MAIN_VER='N/A'; SUB_VER='N/A'; PROD_TAG='N/A'; if [ -d "$MAIN_REPO" ]; then MAIN_VER=$(cd "$MAIN_REPO" && jq -r '.version // "unknown"' package.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); MAIN_SHA=$(cd "$MAIN_REPO" && git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); echo "Main repo:       $MAIN_VER ($MAIN_SHA)"; fi; if [ -d "$DEPLOY_REPO/vessels/$VESSEL" ]; then SUB_VER=$(cd "$DEPLOY_REPO/vessels/$VESSEL" && jq -r '.version // "unknown"' package.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); SUB_SHA=$(cd "$DEPLOY_REPO/vessels/$VESSEL" && git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); echo "Submodule:       $SUB_VER ($SUB_SHA)"; fi; if [ -f "$DEPLOY_REPO/environments/$ENV.values.yaml" ]; then PROD_TAG=$(yq eval '."'$VESSEL'".image.tag // "unknown"' "$DEPLOY_REPO/environments/$ENV.values.yaml" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); echo "Production tag:  $PROD_TAG"; fi; echo ''; if [ "$MAIN_SHA" != "$SUB_SHA" ] && [ "$MAIN_SHA" != 'unknown' ] && [ "$SUB_SHA" != 'unknown' ]; then echo "WARNING: Main repo and submodule are out of sync"; echo "  Main:      $MAIN_SHA"; echo "  Submodule: $SUB_SHA"; fi

tasks.description: Clean untracked files from deployment submodule

config.command: SKIP='{{skipSubmoduleUpdate}}'; DEPLOY_REPO='{{deploymentRepo}}'; VESSEL='{{vesselName}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipSubmoduleUpdate=true'; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -d "$DEPLOY_REPO/vessels/$VESSEL" ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: Vessel directory not found in submodule'; exit 0; fi; echo '=== Cleaning submodule ==='; cd "$DEPLOY_REPO/vessels/$VESSEL"; DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$DIRTY" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Found $DIRTY untracked/modified files"; git status --short; echo ''; echo 'Cleaning...'; git clean -fd; git checkout -- . 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'Cleaned'; else echo 'Submodule is clean'; fi

tasks.description: Fetch and checkout latest commit in submodule

config.command: SKIP='{{skipSubmoduleUpdate}}'; DEPLOY_REPO='{{deploymentRepo}}'; VESSEL='{{vesselName}}'; MAIN_REPO='{{mainRepo}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipSubmoduleUpdate=true'; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -d "$DEPLOY_REPO/vessels/$VESSEL" ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: Vessel directory not found in submodule'; exit 0; fi; echo '=== Updating submodule ==='; cd "$DEPLOY_REPO/vessels/$VESSEL"; BEFORE_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD); echo "Before: $BEFORE_SHA"; git fetch origin; if [ -n "$MAIN_REPO" ] && [ -d "$MAIN_REPO" ]; then TARGET_SHA=$(cd "$MAIN_REPO" && git rev-parse HEAD); echo "Checking out main repo HEAD: $TARGET_SHA"; git checkout $TARGET_SHA; else DEFAULT_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's@^refs/remotes/origin/@@' || echo 'main'); echo "Checking out origin/$DEFAULT_BRANCH"; git checkout origin/$DEFAULT_BRANCH; fi; AFTER_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD); echo "After: $AFTER_SHA"; if [ "$BEFORE_SHA" != "$AFTER_SHA" ]; then echo "Updated: $BEFORE_SHA -> $AFTER_SHA"; else echo "No change (already at latest)"; fi

tasks.description: Detect version and commit SHA from vessel

config.command: cd {{deploymentRepo}}/vessels/{{vesselName}} && VERSION=$(jq -r '.version // "0.1.0"' package.json) && SHA=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD) && echo "VERSION=$VERSION" && echo "SHA=$SHA" && echo "TAG=$VERSION-$SHA"

tasks.description: Update production values with new image tag

config.command: cd {{deploymentRepo}} && TAG=$(cd vessels/{{vesselName}} && echo "$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)") && CURRENT=$(yq eval '."{{vesselName}}".image.tag' environments/{{environment}}.values.yaml) && if [ "$CURRENT" = "$TAG" ]; then echo "Already set to: $TAG"; else yq eval -i '."{{vesselName}}".image.tag = "'$TAG'"' environments/{{environment}}.values.yaml && echo "Updated: $CURRENT -> $TAG"; fi

cd {{deploymentRepo}} && TAG=$(cd vessels/{{vesselName}} && echo "$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)") && docker build -f vessels/{{vesselName}}/Dockerfile -t metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG -t metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:latest vessels/ && echo "Built: metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG"

SKIP='{{skipPush}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipPush=true'; else cd {{deploymentRepo}} && TAG=$(cd vessels/{{vesselName}} && echo "$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)") && docker push metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG && docker push metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:latest && echo "Pushed: metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:$TAG"; fi

tasks.description: Fix any pending or failed helm releases before deploy

config.command: SKIP='{{skipDeploy}}'; NS='{{namespace}}'; VESSEL='{{vesselName}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipDeploy=true'; exit 0; fi; echo '=== Checking Helm Release Status ==='; STATUS=$(helm status $VESSEL -n $NS -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.info.status // "not-found"' || echo 'not-found'); echo "Current status: $STATUS"; if [ "$STATUS" = 'pending-install' ] || [ "$STATUS" = 'pending-upgrade' ] || [ "$STATUS" = 'pending-rollback' ] || [ "$STATUS" = 'failed' ]; then echo "Fixing stuck release (status: $STATUS)..."; REVISION=$(helm history $VESSEL -n $NS -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[0].revision // 0' || echo '0'); if [ "$REVISION" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Rolling back to revision 0 (uninstall and reinstall)"; helm rollback $VESSEL 0 -n $NS 2>/dev/null || helm uninstall $VESSEL -n $NS --wait 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'Fixed'; else echo "No history found, uninstalling..."; helm uninstall $VESSEL -n $NS --wait 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'Uninstalled'; fi; elif [ "$STATUS" = 'not-found' ]; then echo 'Release not found (fresh install)'; else echo "Release healthy (status: $STATUS)"; fi

tasks.description: Deploy with helmfile (fixes field manager conflicts first)

config.command: SKIP='{{skipDeploy}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipDeploy=true'; else cd {{deploymentRepo}} && TAG=$(cd vessels/{{vesselName}} && echo "$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)") && kubectl patch deployment {{vesselName}} -n {{namespace}} --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"{{vesselName}}","image":"metabobapp/{{vesselName}}:'$TAG'"}]}}}}' --field-manager=helm 2>/dev/null || true && helmfile -f helmfile.yaml.gotmpl --environment {{environment}} -l name={{vesselName}} sync; fi

SKIP='{{skipDeploy}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipDeploy=true - no health check needed'; else for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' {{healthEndpoint}}); if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ]; then echo "HEALTHY: $STATUS"; curl -s {{healthEndpoint}} | jq -c .; exit 0; fi; echo "Attempt $i: HTTP $STATUS"; sleep 10; done; echo 'FAILED after 5 attempts'; exit 1; fi

tasks.description: Verify the deployed pod is running the expected image

config.command: SKIP='{{skipDeploy}}'; NS='{{namespace}}'; VESSEL='{{vesselName}}'; if [ "$SKIP" = 'true' ]; then echo 'SKIPPED: skipDeploy=true'; exit 0; fi; echo '=== Verifying Deployed Image ==='; EXPECTED_TAG=$(cd {{deploymentRepo}}/vessels/$VESSEL && echo "$(jq -r '.version' package.json)-$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)"); ACTUAL_IMAGE=$(kubectl get pods -n $NS -l app.kubernetes.io/name=$VESSEL -o jsonpath='{.items[0].spec.containers[0].image}' 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'); echo "Expected tag: $EXPECTED_TAG"; echo "Actual image: $ACTUAL_IMAGE"; if echo "$ACTUAL_IMAGE" | grep -q "$EXPECTED_TAG"; then echo 'VERIFIED: Image matches expected tag'; else echo 'WARNING: Image may not match expected tag'; fi
